scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && docker compose build backend
scripts.coverage:backend: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)/backend:/src" -w /src golang:1.22-alpine sh -lc "/usr/local/go/bin/go test -coverprofile=coverage.out ./... && /usr/local/go/bin/go tool cover -func=coverage.out && /usr/local/go/bin/go tool cover -html=coverage.out -o coverage.html"
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:frontend && npm run coverage:backend
